items.title: The AI sell-off saved Apple from a sell-off of its own
items.summary: A slightly less profitable Apple is still a safe bet against a host of companies trying to ad-lib an AI business model.

items.title: Google to Spend $15 Billion in Malaysia Data Center Expansion
items.summary: Alphabet Inc.’s Google said it plans to spend $15 billion to expand data center and cloud operations in Malaysia as the artificial intelligence boom fuels demand for digital infrastructure.

items.title: Meta Starts Debut Euro Bond Sale After $15 Billion US Deal
items.summary: Meta Platforms Inc. is making its debut in the euro bond market, joining a burst of borrowing by the world’s biggest technology companies as they race to finance trillions of dollars of investments in artificial intelligence.
